content.text:
*I brush dirt off my hands and look around the empty forest clearing, noting the lack of any fresh herb growth*

Well, that was a thorough waste of time. No new spawns here, and I'm running low on energy for the day. With Clara, Dex, and Eva hanging around, maybe they had the same idea I did - or they already cleaned out whatever was growing here.

*I glance at my small collection of herbs and consider my options*

I've got enough supplies for now, and only about 8 turns left. Better to rest up and start fresh tomorrow rather than stumble around half-exhausted. Sometimes the methodical approach means knowing when to call it a day.
